mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail under a Waning Crescent moon. Looking ahead, the temperature will dip to an overnight low of 63 degrees, and we do have rain in the forecast.

City residents have several helpful services available, including the rain barrel rebate program to help with stormwater management and the tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center which offers free rides along the trail.

Today is a busy one with the Dane County Farmers Market, and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can check out the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
Looking at recent reports, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a Madison woman being arrested for O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
Tonight's flavor is the Andes Mint Avalanche, but you will need to get there quickly as the restaurant is closing in less than sixty minutes.
